draft_en.subject: PoE for the cameras on your site units - 4-PoE industrial switch, 30 W or 90 W
draft_en.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Thank you for the 90 W PoE injector order through our shop. A short follow-up on the PoE side of your construction-site units.

For the cameras on an SPP-2S-type unit, a compact industrial switch does the job of several injectors: DIN-rail, 4 x Gigabit PoE+ (30 W per port) + 1 x Gigabit RJ45 + 1 x SFP uplink, -40 to 75 C, 44-57 V DC input, FCC/CE/RoHS - model STI-154GP - $39.2 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity). The 5-port version with a copper uplink only, STI-054GP, is $32.5.

One question: do your units need 90 W (802.3bt) ports for PTZ cameras, or is 30 W per port enough?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
